events.title: Demo Update 0.1.32: New Inventory System & Gameplay Improvements
events.summary: Hello everyone! Since the demo launched, I’ve been watching your gameplay videos and reading your reviews, feedback, and Community Hub discussions. Based on what you’ve shared, I’ve made several improvements to the demo. Here’s what’s new in Update 0.1.32! New Inventory SystemYou can now carry up to four items at once instead of just one. Move supplies around the bakery with fewer trips and keep up with orders more easily. Faster Movement & Toggle SprintPlayer movement speed has been increased.

events.title: Development Update #1 – Bakery Production Improvements
events.summary: Welcome to the first development update for Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator! Recently, I've been focusing on making the bakery feel more alive by replacing instant interactions with fully animated systems. My goal is to make every action in the bakery satisfying to watch. A More Visual Baking Process The preparation process is now fully visible. Instead of an order being completed instantly, each product is placed onto the tray one by one.
